translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Nguluwi kangumlonjela Musa waluche majendo

Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Waluche majendo wuche aha, hegwe na wanhu awo uwalavile kuli isi ya Misili, mlute kuli isi yondimlahile Abulahamu na Isaka na Yakobo, ndilonga, ‘Ndowapa walelwa wa hemwe isi ayi.’
Ndomlajiza mhilisi yawalongoze, ndowawinga Wakanaani na Waamoli na Wahiti na Wapelisi na Wahivi na Wayebusi.
Mlute kuli ayo isi iwele na mboto. Ila kwa vila hemwe ndo muwele na nhumbula zigagadale, siluta hamwe na hemwe, leka ndeche kuwabagamiza mnzila.”
Wanhu nawalila lowahuliche mbuli ayo yihile, kuduhu ne yumwe yavalile vinoligo vya heye.

Nawadita ahyo kwa vila Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Uwalonjele Waisilaeli, ‘Hemwe mwa wanhu wawele na nhumbula zigagadale, wone ndute hamwe na hemwe kwa mhela udo hela, ndowabagamiza. Ahyo, mvule vinoligo vya hemwe leka ndivizele mbuli ya kuwaditila.’ ”
Lelo Waisilaeli nawavula vinoligo vya hewo hala kuchidunda cha Holebu.
Ihema lya Nguluwi liwele Mkulu Nguluwi howeting'hanaga na Musa

Musa nayali na chihendo cha kulihola ihema linji na kulimiza hanze, kutali chidodo na kambi. Ihema alyo nakalipa itagwa, ihema lya nhing'hano. Munhu yoneche yaganile kumlanda Mkulu Nguluwi, nakaluta hala kuli ihema alyo hanze ha kambi.
Chila mhela Musa loyalawile kuluta kuli ihema alyo, chila munhu nakema hali lwizi lwa ihema lya heye na kumlola Musa mbaka hoyokwinjila mgati mwa alyo ihema.
Mhela Musa loyenjile mgati mwa alyo ihema, izengo lya ng'hungugu naligwa kuli lwizi lwa ihema, na Mkulu Nguluwi nakalongasa na heye.
Wanhu weng'ha lowaliwene izengo lya ng'hungugu liwele hala, chila yumwe wa hewo nakafugama hali lwizi lwa ihema lya heye.

Ahyo ndo Mkulu Nguluwi navyoyali yolongasa na Musa hazelu, kota munhu yalingulonga na miyage yeganile na heye. Hamba Musa nakahiluka kahi kuli kambi. Na heye msongolo, Yoshua, na mwana wa Nuni, yawele chitumagwa wa heye nahochile hali ihema.
Mkulu Nguluwi kangulagana kuwa na wanhu wa heye

Musa nakamlonjela Mkulu Nguluwi, “Ulole, hegwe kwangundonjela, ‘Uwalongoze wanhu awa,’ ila hunanzelesa ndo yalihi youmlajiza yanhanze. Ila nakulonga kota kwangunzela kwa itagwa na kahi kota nojezwa na hegwe.
Lelo ndangukudedeza wone kunojezwa na heni, undajile lelo nzila za hegwe leka ndikuzele hegwe, leka kota kowa unojezwe na heni. Ndangulanda ukumbuche kahi kota nhanzi ayi ndo wanhu wa hegwe.”
Nguluwi nakalonga, “Heni baha ndoluta hamwe na hegwe na ndokudita usindamale.”
Musa nakalonga, “Wone gwegwe baho huluta hamwe na heni, lelo uleche kutusa honhu aha.
Mina ndovizela ndaze kota kunojezwa na heni, heni na wanhu wa hegwe, wone hulinguluta hamwe na hetwe? Houluta hamwe na hetwe yotudita tuwe wanhu wa chiuyeng'ha hali wanhu weng'ha wa isi.”
Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Kwa vila heni nojezwa na hegwe, nani ndangukuzela kwa itagwa lyako, mbuli yiyino nayoulonjile ndoidita.”
Musa nakalonga, “Ndangukudedeza undajile ukulu wa hegwe.”

Mkulu Nguluwi nakamwidichila, “Ndokola hali hegwe na kukulajila kunoga kwa heni kweng'ha kuno ndiliwikula itagwa lyangu, ‘Mkulu Nguluwi.’ Ndomonela isungu munhu yula yondigana kumonela isungu, ndochisinza kwa munhu yula yondilingugana ndisinze.
Ila huweza kumbona kumeho mina kuduhu munhu yoneche yombona na kuwa mkomu.”
Hamba Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Kuna honhu behi na heni hawele houkwima mchanya mwa italawe,
na ukulu wa heni houwa ukola, ndokuwika mli mhalika mitalawe na kukugubika kwa moko ga heni, mbaka hondiwa ng'holile.
Hamba ndokusa moko wa heni nagwe kochona chigosi cha heni, ila kumeho kwa heni hukona hebu.”
